summary.intent: Execute phase 20 (vault-migration) of cipher-box, implementing vault blob v2 binary format across the TypeScript core library, NestJS API, Rust desktop app, and web client with lazy user migration on login.
summary.outcome: All 4 plans executed and verified. The vault blob v2 format works end-to-end: migration triggers on first non-migrated login, migrated users read rootFolderKey from IPFS v2 blobs, and folder sync handles v2 blobs transparently. Several bugs surfaced during UAT were discovered and fixed before checkpoint approval.

repo: NestJS does not auto-log incoming requests — a successful POST /vault/migrate appeared as a 'silent failure' until the DB was queried directly to confirm migrated_at was set.
Orval generates `{ [key: string]: unknown } | null` instead of `string | null` for nullable string fields; `as unknown as string` casts are the correct workaround for this pre-existing codegen bug.
The IPFS gateway at port 8080 exposes CORS-friendly `/ipns/{name}` path resolution (Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *), but Kubo's API port 5001 sends no CORS headers and is unusable from the browser.
The IPNS controller requires JWT auth — it cannot be called from the offline recovery tool.
The delegated routing API (/routing/v1/ipns/{name}) returns CBOR-wrapped records, not raw protobuf; naive protobuf parsing returns garbage bytes as the CID.
IPNS records published to a local Kubo node do not automatically propagate to the public DHT — public gateways (ipfs.io, delegated-ipfs.dev) will 404 for locally-published records.
OTPs from Web3Auth are logged in clear text to the API server stdout in the dev environment.

code.finding: fetchAndDecryptMetadata blindly JSON.parsed the raw IPFS blob — crashed with SyntaxError on v2 binary format. Fixed by detecting blob version before parsing.
Same JSON.parse-without-version-check bug as folder.service.ts; both needed the same v2 blob detection fix.

Migration IIFE: duplicate HKDF derivation (deriveVaultIpnsKeypair called twice with identical inputs) and redundant destructure/re-wrap of ipnsKeypair. Also: PATH A re-derived the keypair instead of reusing it from login.
fetchFromIpfs returned undefined on non-404 gateway errors (loop fell through); detectBlobVersion then crashed on undefined.length. Fixed with explicit undefined guard and clear error message.
Double ECIES wrap: vault init wrapped rootFolderKey once for DB storage, then wrapped it again with the same key for the v2 blob. Fixed by reusing the first wrapped result.
serialize_vault_blob_v2 lacked key length bounds checks — oversized keys would silently truncate to u16 max on cast. Changed return type to Result and added validation.
InitVaultRequest and VaultResponse derived Debug, leaking encrypted key material to logs. Replaced with custom Debug impls that redact sensitive fields.

workflow: When an API call appears to have never fired, query the database directly before concluding it failed — NestJS silence does not mean the request was never received.
The GSD security:review command's subagent can run concurrently with an active user checkpoint (wave 3 paused waiting for human approval), effectively parallelizing security review with UAT.
Playwright browser automation is available in the session and can execute JavaScript in the active browser context, enabling direct Zustand store access for extracting keys during manual testing.
The /gsd:debug workflow spawns a fresh gsd-debugger subagent with isolated context — useful when investigation requires extensive file reads that would bloat the orchestrator context.

For IPFS/IPNS resolution in offline recovery tools, fetching /ipns/{name} directly from the IPFS gateway (port 8080) is simpler and more reliable than delegated routing APIs or Kubo's auth-required API.

friction: Silent NestJS request logging caused significant time lost investigating a 'failed' migration that had actually succeeded — required direct DB query to confirm.
First security:review invocation failed with ConnectionRefused mid-execution; had to be re-invoked.
Public IPFS gateways could not resolve locally-published IPNS records, requiring multiple failed approaches (Kubo API, CipherBox API, delegated routing) before landing on the /ipns/ gateway path.
Kubo API port 5001 has no CORS headers, blocking all browser-initiated requests; discovered only after implementing the fallback.
The delegated routing API's CBOR response format was not documented — the existing protobuf parser silently returned garbage bytes as the resolved CID.
Orval codegen bug for nullable string fields required `as unknown as string` casts throughout vault-related API response handling; regenerating the client after DTO changes had no effect.
open_items: Recovery tool: private key (Uint8Array) not zeroed from memory after use (security review M-1)
useAuth.ts: no deduplication guard for concurrent migration from multiple browser tabs — two tabs logging in simultaneously could both trigger POST /vault/migrate (security review M-2)
vault.rs FUSE publish: rootFolderKey is ECIES-re-wrapped on every root folder publish rather than cached in AppState (security review M-3)
Blob deserializers accept zero-length keys without error (security review L-1)
recovery.html: no SRI hashes on CDN script tags (security review L-2)
Device registry sync fails with 'CryptoError: Invalid registry format' — schema mismatch between current registry format and stored IPFS data (pre-existing, captured as todo)
bin IPNS name resolution returns 404 — bin-specific IPNS record may be missing or the record format changed (pre-existing, captured as todo)
IPNS records are only published to the local Kubo node and do not propagate to the public DHT — production deployment will need DHT publishing configured
